fact: Beck Personal Site is an active PARA project at ~/life/projects/beck-personal-site for replacing the current Squarespace-backed beckcherry.com site with a React build.
Beck wants the replacement personal site to keep the beckcherry.com domain while using React and cheap/easy hosting instead of paying for a site builder plus hosting.
On July 9, 2026, Beck set the public-facing direction for the site as personal and creative, more visual, less wordy, with solid colors and fewer gradients.

The new personal site should include Who I Am, Nan’s Recipes, Contact, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Blog, with Blog, Nan’s Recipes, and Contact living inside the new site; X and Occupy Greenland should be removed.

On July 12, 2026, Beck changed the page plan so the site should keep Blog, Nan’s Recipes, About/Who I Am, YouTube, and LinkedIn in the new site, while the old Contact-page idea is replaced by an About Me / links-style page; X and Occupy Greenland should still be removed.
On July 12, 2026, Beck set the current homepage/header rule to use the face-only image from beckcherry.com as the header/logo asset and not use the face+name version there.
On July 12, 2026, Beck required the homepage hero to fit fully within the first mobile screen even with browser toolbars visible, to stay properly centered, and to use a burger menu on mobile.
On July 12, 2026, Beck decided not to use a site contact form for now and to prioritize getting the email signup flow working before other site forms.

On July 13, 2026, Beck deferred email-signup setup until he is back at a laptop, and the preferred implementation path became a 100% free Google Apps Script + Google Sheet flow rather than Google Cloud service-account setup.
On July 14, 2026, beckcherry.com finished its custom-domain cutover and now resolves to the Vercel deployment of the React personal site.
On July 14, 2026, Beck chose MailerLite as the simplest reliable reusable newsletter-sending tool; Google Sheets + Apps Script can remain the lightweight signup-capture path.

On July 14, 2026, the personal site cleanup/performance pass reduced the initial app JavaScript from about 1.07 MB to about 15.8 KB by splitting content data, lazy-loading the Adventures page, and moving atlas data out of the main bundle before redeploying to beckcherry.com.
source: 2026-07-14 personal-site cleanup + JS bundle optimization session

fact: On July 15, 2026, Beck kept the existing signup-capture flow in place for now and moved the preferred outbound newsletter path to Resend on a sending subdomain, with own-branding only, no mailbox requirement, and a no-reply sender.
On July 15, 2026, Beck required newsletter emails for the personal site to use only his own branding and to be maintained as a repo-owned template rather than relying on third-party branding.
